station.name: Sion
station.note: Official MeteoSwiss climsheet and the NOAA WMO CSV were not reachable from this run (proxy / permission). Values taken from the Wikipedia climate box for Sion, which cites NOAA 'World Meteorological Organization Climate Normals for 1991-2020' (Sion_06720.csv) and the MeteoSwiss climsheet SIO np9120. Monthly sums equal the printed annual totals. Cross-check: climatsetvoyages.com 1991-2020 summary, rounded: 585 mm, 2,135 h. Marker coordinates approximate (Sion airfield station).

comparison_station.name: Zurich-Fluntern
comparison_station.note: Wikipedia climate box 1991-2020, Source 1: NOAA, Source 2: MeteoSwiss, KNMI. Monthly sums equal annual totals.

facts.claim: Valais vineyard 4,577.7 ha in 2025 (1,931.6 ha white, 2,646.1 ha red)
facts.source: BLW, Das Weinjahr 2025 (via Open Wine Atlas details-ch.json vine_area_ha)

facts.claim: Largest wine canton of Switzerland, about a third of the national vineyard, along the upper Rhône valley from Lake Geneva to Brig
facts.source: Open Wine Atlas atlas_note (BLW data); Swiss Wine: Valais = 32% of Swiss vineyard

facts.claim: Terrain e=[372,2141,4463,986,3116] m over the canton outline: min 372, max 4463, relief 4091
Vineyards often terraced; vines at 1,100 m above sea level in Visperterminen
facts.source: Swiss Wine Promotion, Valais wine region

facts.claim: Sion annual precipitation 583.0 mm vs Zurich-Fluntern 1,107.9 mm (1991-2020); ratio 1.9
facts.source: MeteoSwiss data, WMO normals 1991-2020 via NOAA

facts.claim: Sion annual sunshine 2,157.9 h vs Zurich-Fluntern 1,694.3 h; difference 464 h
facts.source: MeteoSwiss data, WMO normals 1991-2020 via NOAA

facts.claim: Sion July mean max 27.4 °C, January mean min -3.0 °C
facts.source: MeteoSwiss data, WMO normals 1991-2020 via NOAA

facts.claim: Sion April-October mean temperature 16.1 °C (derived from monthly daily means)
WSET bands: cool up to about 16.5 °C growing season average, moderate 16.5-18.5 °C
facts.source: Open Wine Atlas study lesson (Foundations, climate)

facts.claim: Grape shares of the Valais vineyard: Pinot Noir 26.7%, Chasselas 16.1%, Gamay 9.5%, Sylvaner 7.2%, Petite Arvine 6.1%
facts.source: BLW, Das Weinjahr 2025, tables 1.2 and 1.3 (via Open Wine Atlas grape_share)

facts.claim: Traditional names: Fendant = Chasselas, Johannisberg = Sylvaner, Malvoisie = Pinot Gris, Dôle = Pinot Noir alone or at least 85% Pinot Noir with Gamay
facts.source: Ordonnance sur la vigne et le vin (OVV), RS VS 916.142, art. 49 to 61
